add.subtitle: Edit an existing item or add a new item to the database.
add.help_edit_p1: Low Stock Alerts highlight components whose quantity has fallen below the defined minimum stock level.
add.help_edit_p2: This helps you notice parts that may soon run out, so you can restock them before they become unavailable during work.
add.help_edit_p3: Alerts are informational only — they do not block usage or trigger automatic actions.
add.help_edit_p4: Minimum stock values are defined per component and can be adjusted at any time.
add.help_add_p1: This form is used to add new physical components to the workshop inventory.
add.help_add_p2: Basic details such as category, quantity, and location are entered manually.
add.help_add_p3: Optional API services can be used to automatically fill in technical data like name, description, datasheet, and image, helping speed up the initial entry process.
add.help_add_p4: API usage is intended as a convenience feature and does not replace manual verification or editing.
add.min_stock_help: Alert will be triggered below this level.
add.just_added: Component saved. Ready for next entry.
add.error.required_fields: Component Name, Part Number, and Category are required.

add.error.part_number_exists: Error: Part Number already exists in the inventory.
add.edit.error.required_fields: Name, Quantity, and Min. Stock Level are required.
